title: Black Square
statementMd:
Quite recently, a very smart student named Jury decided that lectures are boring, so he downloaded a game called "`Black Square`" on his super cool touchscreen phone.

In this game, the phone's screen is divided into four vertical strips. Each second, a black square appears on some of the strips. According to the rules of the game, Jury must use this second to touch the corresponding strip to make the square go away. As Jury is both smart and lazy, he counted that he wastes exactly $*a*_{*i*}$ calories on touching the $*i*$-th strip.

You've got a string $*s*$, describing the process of the game and numbers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4}$. Calculate how many calories Jury needs to destroy all the squares?

## Input

The first line contains four space-separated integers $*a*_{1}$, $*a*_{2}$, $*a*_{3}$, $*a*_{4}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4} ≤ 10^{4}$).

The second line contains string $*s*$ ($1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 10^{5}$), where the $*і*$-th character of the string equals "`1`", if on the $*i*$-th second of the game the square appears on the first strip, "`2`", if it appears on the second strip, "`3`", if it appears on the third strip, "`4`", if it appears on the fourth strip.

## Output

Print a single integer — the total number of calories that Jury wastes.
statementZhMd:
最近，一名叫 Jury 的聪明学生认为讲课很无聊，于是他在自己超酷的触屏手机上下载了一款名为 `Black Square` 的游戏。

在这个游戏中，手机屏幕被分成四个竖直条带。每秒钟，某个条带上会出现一个黑色方块。根据游戏规则，Jury 必须在这一秒内触摸对应的条带，使方块消失。Jury 既聪明又懒惰，他计算出触摸第 $*i*$ 个条带恰好会消耗 $*a*_{*i*}$ 卡路里。

现在给你一个字符串 $*s*$，它描述了游戏的过程，以及四个数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4}$。请计算 Jury 消灭所有方块需要消耗多少卡路里？

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4}$（$0 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3}, *a*_{4} ≤ 10^{4}$）。

第二行包含字符串 $*s*$（$1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 10^{5}$）。其中，字符串的第 $*і*$ 个字符等于 `1`，表示游戏进行到第 $*і*$ 秒时，方块出现在第一个条带上；等于 `2`，表示方块出现在第二个条带上；等于 `3`，表示方块出现在第三个条带上；等于 `4`，表示方块出现在第四个条带上。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即 Jury 消耗的卡路里总数。
